title: GPU prototype feasibility decision and cleanup
description:
Close the GPU prototype wave with a documented feasibility decision and a cleaned-up HIP-only issue graph.

## Background

Epic `806eb14e` is a prototype and feasibility effort, not a production backend rollout. Existing Vulkan/GLSL children and downstream production-backend scope must be reconciled before the epic can close.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Legacy Vulkan/GLSL children are rewritten or closed as superseded so the epic graph no longer implies Vulkan scope.
- [hard] Downstream production backend work is detached or reframed as later work conditioned on this epic's evidence.
- [hard] A final feasibility report maps every epic success criterion to child issues and artifacts.
- [hard] The report includes baseline IDs, commit hashes, hardware metadata, ROCm version, benchmark commands, and raw result paths.
- [hard] The report states go/investigate/abandon for LDPC BP and BCH syndrome evaluation and explains why.

## Notes

Spec doc: `dev/plans/hip_gpu_prototype_wave.md`. This story depends on scheduler, LDPC, and BCH stories.
